topic: Asking About a Car Loan Payment

script.title: THE CAR PAYMENT
script.title_quote: So I save money by paying more
script.story_hook: One early payment starts a friendly money lesson.
script.intro_zh: 一筆提前扣款的小虛驚,讓他看懂車貸的每個數字。
script.welcome_en: Hi! Today: understanding your car payment.
script.welcome_zh: 你好!今天來學看懂汽車貸款的繳款。
script.outro: Sixty lines — that loan looks friendly now. Drive safe!
script.outro_zh: 六十句聽完,貸款看起來友善多了。開車小心!
script.practice_intro_en: Your turn — repeat each line out loud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 換你了——大聲跟著唸每一句。
script.char_a_description: a middle-aged man with short salt-and-pepper hair and rimless glasses, wearing a brown quilted vest over a red flannel shirt, dark jeans and work boots, broad shoulders, holding a folded loan statement
script.char_b_description: a young woman with dark brown hair pulled into a high bun, wearing a teal cardigan over a white collared shirt, a black pencil skirt and flat shoes, a silver name badge on her chest

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I called earlier about my car loan.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ kɔld ˈɜrliər əˈbaʊt maɪ kɑr loʊn/
dialogue.zh: 你好,我之前打過電話,問我的汽車貸款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right! You're here about the payment.
dialogue.zh: 想起來了!你是來談每月繳款的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. It leaves my account every month.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt livz maɪ əˈkaʊnt ˈɛvri mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 對,它每個月都從我的帳戶自動扣走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Auto-pay — the quiet money hero.
dialogue.zh: 自動繳款——不聲不響的省錢小幫手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hero? It just took my cash early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɪroʊ ɪt dʒʌst tʊk maɪ kæʃ ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 小幫手?它剛剛還提前把錢扣走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh! The car payment left early?
dialogue.zh: 噢!車貸那筆款提前扣了?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yep. Tuesday — my due day is Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ˈtuzdeɪ maɪ du deɪ ɪz ˈθɜrzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對,週二就扣了,可我繳款日是週四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, that's not our schedule…
dialogue.zh: 嗯,這不是我們排定的日子……

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I call the number on my bill?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kɔl ðə ˈnʌmbər ɑn maɪ bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我該打電話問帳單上那支電話嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One second — let me peek online.
dialogue.zh: 稍等——我上網看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure. At least nothing's broken?
dialogue.zh: 好。至少,錢沒有出錯吧?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it! We switched payment days.
dialogue.zh: 找到了!我們改了扣款的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Switched? Since when? By how much?
dialogue.zh: 改了?從什麼時候?提早多少?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New rule this spring — two days early.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu rul ðɪs sprɪŋ tu deɪz ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 今年春天新規定——提前兩天扣款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, wow. I was worried there.
dialogue.zh: 噢,我剛剛真是擔心死了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair! Many folks called that week.
dialogue.zh: 難怪!那週好多人都打電話來問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm one of the many, apparently.
dialogue.zh: 很明顯,我就是那好多分之一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Now — want your bill explained?
dialogue.zh: 哈!那——想不想我把帳單講清楚?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please. It looks like a maze.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz ɪt lʊks laɪk ə meɪz/
dialogue.zh: 太好了,那張單子看起來像迷宮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two lines matter: principal, interest.
dialogue.zh: 重要的有兩行:本金和利息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two-seventy-fifty is the principal?
dialogue.zh: 兩百七十五塊是本金嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — that's the loan getting smaller.
dialogue.zh: 對——那一行就是貸款在變小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And forty-five? What's that one for?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈfɔrti faɪv wʌts ðæt wʌn fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那四十五塊呢?那是什麼費用?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The interest — today's cost of borrowing.
dialogue.zh: 利息——就是借錢在當今的代價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty-five dollars for one month? Ouch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti faɪv ˈdɑlərz fər wʌn mʌnθ aʊtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 一個月四十五塊?哎喲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The good news: it shrinks monthly.
dialogue.zh: 好消息是,它會一個月比一個月少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So next year, less interest?
dialogue.zh: 所以明年的利息會更少?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the principal share grows.
dialogue.zh: 對,而且本金那一行會變多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. So how much is left anyway?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs soʊ haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz lɛft ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不錯。那到底還剩多少沒繳?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Balance now: eight thousand, one-seventy.
dialogue.zh: 目前餘額:八千一百七十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's less than I thought!
dialogue.zh: 比我想像中的少耶!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good surprise beats a bad one.
dialogue.zh: 好消息總比壞消息強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay extra, say a hundred?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pe ˈɛkstræ seɪ ə ˈhʌndrəd/
dialogue.zh: 我可以多繳一點嗎,比如說一百?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Every extra hits principal.
dialogue.zh: 可以!多繳的每一塊都直接進本金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Straight to principal? No fees?
dialogue.zh: 直接進本金?沒有手續費?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None — just note 'apply to principal.'
dialogue.zh: 沒有——只要註明『請扣進本金』。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Note it where — in the app?
dialogue.zh: 要在哪裡註明?手機程式裡嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a small box to check.
dialogue.zh: 有一個小方框可以勾選。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it! Sneaky, but simple.
dialogue.zh: 找到了!藏得巧,但不難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A hundred extra saves you interest.
dialogue.zh: 多繳一百塊,就能省下一些利息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much interest, roughly?
dialogue.zh: 大約能省下多少利息?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About two hundred, if you do it monthly.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt tu ˈhʌndrəd ɪf ju du ɪt ˈmʌnθli/
dialogue.zh: 如果你每個月都多繳一百,大概能省兩百。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I save money by paying more?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ seɪv ˈmʌni baɪ ˈpeɪɪŋ mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 所以我多繳錢,反而省錢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Math magic of early principal.
dialogue.zh: 這就是提前繳本金的數學魔術。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll do one this month, then.
dialogue.zh: 那這個月我來多繳一筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Love that. Now — autopay perks?
dialogue.zh: 很棒!接著——自動繳款有什麼優惠?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perks? Besides leaving two days early?
dialogue.zh: 優惠?除了會提前兩天扣款之外?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, fair. It knocks off ten dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛr ɪt nɑks ɔf tɛn ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 哈,說得對。自動繳款可以折抵十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten dollars? Off every month?
dialogue.zh: 十塊?每個月都折抵?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every month — that's a hundred twenty a year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri mʌnθ ðæts ə ˈhʌndrəd ˈtwɛnti ə jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 每個月都折,一年就是一百二十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now you're talking my language!
dialogue.zh: 你終於說到我心坎裡了!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sign the form, done in two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪn ðə fɔrm dʌn ɪn tu ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 簽張表格,兩分鐘就搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. Can I also sell the car soon?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil kæn aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ sɛl ðə kɑr sun/
dialogue.zh: 成交。那我很快就能把車賣掉嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure — want a payoff quote today?
dialogue.zh: 當然——今天要先拿一份結清報價嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! What is a payoff quote, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌt ɪz ə ˈpeɪˌɔf kwaʊt ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 要!確切說,結清報價是什麼?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Final price to own it outright.
dialogue.zh: 就是把車徹底買斷的最後價位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So one payment and the car's mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌn ˈpeɪmənt ænd ðə kɑrz maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 所以繳清一次,車就完全是我的?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then they mail you the title.
dialogue.zh: 之後銀行會把所有權證明寄給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Payoff sheet, autopay form — you're a lifesaver.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪˌɔf ʃit ˈɔtoʊˌpeɪ fɔrm jʊr ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvər/
dialogue.zh: 結清單、自動繳款表——你真是救星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy that debt-free feeling!
dialogue.zh: 好好享受『無貸一身輕』的感覺吧!
